_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Maintenance Manual Changes
summary: Provides format and content preparation instructions for documenting detailed changes to existing Government maintenance manuals resulting from approved additions, deletions, or modifications to a component, equipment, or system.
use_relationship:
Maintenance Manual Changes to existing Government manuals, provide detailed changes pertaining to a specific component, equipment, or system affected by any Government approved addition, deletion, or change.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract and paragraphs 6-1, 6-2, and 6-3 of DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals.

This DID is applicable to manuals prepared specifically for the Government.

Not authorized for use with Air Force Technical Orders (TOs).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals is available at the National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md 20755-6718; Attn: I8222.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Changes to the Maintenance Manual Changes shall be in accordance with paragraphs 6-1, 6-2, and 6-3 of DS-56.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The change(s) shall be consistent with the existing content requirement of the manual.
